body:
Measured, same green commit `3a240b7fb`, all tests:

| Run | Machine | Cache | Wall time | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Post-merge gate (batch tier, steps one at a time) | self-hosted runner | warm | **53.4 min** (898 steps; sum of step times 44.9 min) | green |
| `cargo nextest run` (same scope as batch: workspace minus kernel, minus SLOW_BINARIES, no ignored) + batch clippy | Hetzner ccx43, 16 vCPU | **cold, sccache off** | **18.8 min** (build + tests 17.4 min, of which tests 12.3 min; clippy 1.4 min) | **8465 tests run: 8465 passed**, 77 skipped |

Average CPU during the nextest run: 80 % (load 27 on 16 vCPU). The batch gate's own log shows why it is slow: 731 of 898 steps take <= 1 s, and the floor is the build (237 s) plus the longest step (motion lib, 287 s), about 9 min with full parallelism.

So nextest (or lanes in `xtask`) is about 3x faster from a cold start; with a warm cache it should come in well under the 53 min. Scripts: `cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude camcraft-kernel --no-fail-fast -E 'not (binary(finish3d) & package(camcraft-motion)) and not (binary(pivot5d) & package(camcraft-motion)) and not (binary(flow) & package(camcraft-motion)) and not (binary(center_cut_multiaxis) & package(camcraft-app))'`. Not yet checked: doc-tests (nextest skips them), and whether the gate's known-fail/VOID bookkeeping maps onto nextest's output.
claimed: Antigravity (len) · 2026-11-19T15:36:07Z · branch mkinney:issue/2727-batch-gate-lanes · plan: split prebuilds by feature set and run batch suites through the parallel lane queue

Released claim due to a local `cargo` / `sccache` runner block. Held work is on `mkinney:issue/2727-batch-gate-lanes` (`41cf2fcf1`, based on `e5b0ca3c1`).

### Blocker
Starting at `17:58:54+01:00`, every `cargo` command in the agent runner failed on `sccache: error: Connection to server timed out: Os { code: 111, kind: ConnectionRefused, message: "Connection refused" }`, even with `BypassSandbox: true`. Host `sccache` stayed up on `127.0.0.1:4228`, and direct `sccache rustc -vV` calls passed, while `cargo` calls failed before building. This blocked running `gate batch`, `gate quick --base upstream/main`, and `cargo clippy` after writing `docs/decisions/2727-batch-gate-lanes.md`.

### Held changes (`41cf2fcf1`)
- `xtask/src/plan.rs`: `debug_build_crate` prebuilds each crate in `BATCH_CRATES` and `ui` separately so Cargo feature unification no longer forces suite steps to recompile.
- `xtask/src/exec.rs`, `xtask/src/queue.rs`, `xtask/src/main.rs`: `Run::lanes` and `Run::run_lanes` run `batch` (and `quick` fallback to `batch`) in parallel lanes while keeping prebuilds, `ISOLATED` targets, `ui`, and `clippy` alone.
- `xtask/src/lanes.rs`: `lanes::history_for` reads the newest `batch-*` or `release-*` `timings.tsv` for `batch` and `quick`, and `release-*` only for `release`.
- `xtask/src/step_tests.rs`, `xtask/src/lanes_tests.rs`, `xtask/src/tests.rs`: pinning tests for per-crate prebuilds, suite freshness, parallel lanes, and `timings.tsv` history.

### Observed before the block
- On `upstream/main` `971c23faa`, `cargo xtask gate batch` (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, cold target, no `timings.tsv`) ran `929` steps in `45.2 min` (`summed lane wall time 5640s`). Only prebuild logs `01`..`09` and `929-clippy` logged `Compiling `; no suite log compiled crates. Only `ui suites: lib` failed (`frame_cost_probe.rs:278`), which `upstream/main` later fixed in PR `#2767` (`9ff2dda25`).
- After fast-forwarding to `e5b0ca3c1`, `cargo test -p xtask` passed `203` tests (`181` unit and `22` integration), and `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with `0` warnings.

### Remaining steps
1. Add `docs/decisions/2727-batch-gate-lanes.md`.
2. Run `cargo xtask gate batch` (warm check with `timings.tsv`), `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, and `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
3. Update the commit trailer from `Refs #2727` to `Fixes #2727`, push, and open the draft PR with `Process change: yes`.
